item.title: Version 1.5.50
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.50 Update

  • 💎 macOS 26 Liquid Glass Settings
    - Redesigned the macOS 26 settings window with Liquid Glass styling across General, Actions, Inline AI, and License tabs.
    - Added an option to keep using the classic settings window on macOS 26.
    - Preserved the existing settings window for older macOS versions.
  • ✨ Actions Settings Redesign
    - Rebuilt the Actions tab around a floating panel preview, inline action details, and a compact unused actions list.
    - Added drag and drop for arranging actions, moving actions in and out of folders, and managing unused actions more naturally.
  • 🔧 Selection and Replacement Reliability
    - Improved selected text handling in apps that do not expose selection through Accessibility APIs.
    - Simplified replacement behavior and removed the Direct Replacement Blocklist setting.
  • 🎨 UI Polish
    - Improved dark mode contrast in Action Library.
    - Refined Inline AI controls, app icon lists, License tab spacing, and alert icons so they use the selected OnText app icon.
